summary: W7 Phase 1 business acceptance handoff. Coding/Repair must implement the approved five-purpose business benchmark and seven-wave delivery gate so whole delivery is allowed only after W2-W6 are accepted and DT-18 proves 100% key seed recall, 100% closure correctness, zero forced unrelated hits, and recorded precision.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the approved five-purpose business benchmark after W2-W6 acceptance evidence is available.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Every purpose reports mandatory key seed ids, recalled key seed ids, no missing key seeds, expected closure correctness, zero forced hits for unrelated controls, recorded precision, aggregate recall 1, aggregate closure correctness 1, and no invented release precision threshold.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Attempt W7 or whole delivery with incomplete W2-W6 evidence, with W2-W6 accepted but DT-18 missing or failing, and with a fully passing ordered control case.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The delivery gate blocks incomplete prerequisites, blocks whole delivery until W7 DT-18 passes, and allows delivery only after W2-W6 plus W7 business benchmark evidence pass.

criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect root and Graph RAG contracts for W7 quality benchmark and delivery sequence boundary declarations.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Contracts declare evaluatePhase1QualityBenchmark, evaluateDeliverySequence, 100% recall, 100% closure correctness, zero forced hits, recorded precision, and prerequisite wave gating.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: DependencyDirectionGuard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect production runtime modules for outward dependencies on tests.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Production Graph RAG runtime code does not import tests or frozen entrypoint assets.

criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Entrypoints keep GIVEN/WHEN/THEN readability, use the production Harness abstraction, and include DT-18 and TS-08 failure categories.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: KeyImplementationTraceabilityGuard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect intent anchors, root contract mappings, and mounted W7 testcase paths.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Implementation mappings reference grag-quality-gate and grag-seven-wave-delivery, and mounted DT-18/TS-08 entrypoints exist.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: CodingScopeAuthorizationGuard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect W7 coding targets, task plan, frozen files, and top-level authorization fields.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The handoff authorizes only DT-18 and TS-08 delivery-sequence scope, keeps DT-19 capacity evidence out of Coding scope, and preserves runner-owned deliveryStatus authority.

codingTargets.nextAction: Add createProductionGraphRagRuntime().evaluatePhase1QualityBenchmark(request) that evaluates the approved five-purpose business benchmark and returns per-purpose and aggregate qualityEvidence with recall 1, closure correctness 1, unrelated forced hits 0, recorded precision, and no release precision threshold.

Add createProductionGraphRagRuntime().evaluateDeliverySequence(request) that blocks missing W2-W6 prerequisites, blocks whole delivery when DT-18 is missing or failing, and allows delivery only after prerequisite and W7 benchmark evidence pass.

taskExecutionPlan.executionStrategy: Implement W7 as business acceptance after W2-W6, without changing W4 seed retrieval, W5 purpose closure, W6 structural/provenance evidence, graph-tidy full-snapshot behavior, DT-19 capacity governance, or runner-owned deliveryStatus by hand. tasks.title: Evaluate phase-one quality benchmark
tasks.objective: Expose business evidence for the approved five-purpose benchmark.
steps: Add evaluatePhase1QualityBenchmark(request) to createProductionGraphRagRuntime's returned public boundary.
Consume the Harness-provided benchmark purposes without inventing a precision release threshold or result cap.
Return qualityEvidence.benchmarkId, purposes, perPurpose observations, keySeedRecall 1, closureCorrectness 1, unrelatedForcedHits 0, aggregatePrecision, and undefined releasePrecisionThreshold.
tasks.completionSignal: runRetrievalQualityBenchmark.js exits 0 and DT-18 records 100% recall, 100% closure correctness, zero forced unrelated hits, and precision evidence.

tasks.title: Gate whole delivery sequence
tasks.objective: Block W7 and whole delivery until prerequisites and DT-18 quality evidence pass.
steps: Add evaluateDeliverySequence(request) to the production runtime public boundary.
For incomplete prerequisites, return blocked with category DELIVERY_PREREQUISITES_INCOMPLETE and exact missing waves from W2 through W6.
For whole-delivery attempts with missing or failed qualityBenchmark evidence, return blocked with category W7_QUALITY_BENCHMARK_REQUIRED.
For W2-W6 accepted plus passed DT-18 evidence, return status allowed and releaseAllowed true.
tasks.completionSignal: runSevenWaveDeliveryGates.js exits 0 with prerequisite blocking, W7-quality blocking, and ordered delivery allowance proven.

tasks.title: Verify W7 release gate
tasks.objective: Prove W7 without broadening into DT-19 or manual deliveryStatus edits.
steps: Run the two W7 explicit entrypoints.
Run npm run test:argo or argo.runArchitectureTests to refresh failure records and runner-owned delivery evidence.
Confirm DT-19 capacity evidence remains out of implementation scope unless a later approved handoff includes it.
